current.text: Zion is locked into the Pelicans' starting lineup.
He projects for only about 30 minutes. Guards who handle the ball limit any point-forward role for him.
Using him more off the ball instead of as a point forward is probably part of why he stayed healthy.
New Orleans has among the most back-to-backs in the league.
Experts expect the Pelicans to rest him often, and the back-to-backs make that a real risk.
Josh thinks he is worth about 6 USD in an auction. In his mock draft, bidding opened at 3 USD and he went for 8 USD.
Experts think he is being drafted too early. They call an ESPN ADP of 46 too high and say mock picks around 50 to 58 are early.
His best case is about top 20, but the expert doubts that version of Zion still exists.
Year eight is a make-or-break season for him. He is the player under the most pressure on the team.
The Pelicans have a new head coach, Jamahl Mosley, who brings a defense-first identity.
The Pelicans have more rotation players than minutes, so roles are hard to project. The group includes Murray, Fears, Jones, Murphy, Bey, Missi, Queen and the newly added Mathurin.
Experts think Zion and Derik Queen do not fit together. Yves Missi looks set to start at center over Queen.
Saddiq Bey may close games in lineups where Zion plays center.
Experts see the Pelicans as a weak team near the bottom of the West. One projects about 34 wins and no playoffs.

durable.text: He is a high-volume scorer with a strong FG%, which lifts a team's FG% clearly.
His FT% is weak on real volume, so he hurts a team's FT%.
He makes almost no threes and does not space the floor.
He is not a good rebounder and does not play defense.
He is worth much more in points leagues than in category leagues.
He has high upside, but his health is a lasting worry.

note: Zion is a punt FT% and punt 3PM piece. He gives a big FG% lift (+3.1 z) and good scoring, but about 70% FT on 7.6 attempts and no threes. Josh values him at about 6 USD and Yahoo at 12 USD (ESPN 3 USD), so the 21 USD our league paid last season is far too much. Above roughly 10 USD, the risk from rest and health outweighs the upside. Early in the season, check whether he stays near 30 minutes, whether New Orleans sits him on back-to-backs, and whether he plays center in closing lineups.
